'''Galloway''' is a male student from the Department of Voidmatters, seen talking with '''Kuangda''' from the Department of Light Energy Sciences.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Galloway:''' This daily hike is killing me...
:'''Galloway:''' Why can't the school build the dorms closer to the classrooms? Huff puff...
:'''Kuangda:''' You'll get used to it, brother...
:'''Galloway:''' Hey, your badge... You're from the Agro Wing, right? Aren't your test plots even farther out?
:'''Kuangda:''' Yep. And we have to keep watch to make sure no mech reindeer wander in and eat our "thesis material"...
:'''Galloway:''' So you must've complained to the school a long time ago.
:'''Kuangda:''' We solved the problem already.
:'''Galloway:''' But how? Did the school move your dorms? Or  did you invent some new transport tech?
:'''Kuangda:''' Nah. We just started sleeping in the plots.
{{Dialogue End}}
